paragraphs.text: 1. THOU, bearer of oblations, though kindled, art kindled for the Gods.
With the Adityas, Rudras, Vasus, come to us: to show us favour come to us.
paragraphs.original: आदित्यै रुद्रैर्वसुभिर्न आ गहि मृळीकाय न आ गहि
paragraphs.translit: ādityai rudrairvasubhirna ā gahi mṛḷīkāya na ā gahi

paragraphs.text: 2. Come hither and accept with joy this sacrifice and hymn of ours.
O kindled God, we mortals are invoking thee, calling on thee to show us grace.
3. I laud thee Jatavedas, thee Lord of all blessings, with my song.
Agni, bring hitherward the Gods whose Laws we love, whose laws we love, to show us grace.
paragraphs.original: अग्ने देवाँ आ वह नः प्रियव्रतान्मृळीकाय प्रियव्रतान्
paragraphs.translit: agne devām̐ ā vaha naḥ priyavratānmṛḷīkāya priyavratān

paragraphs.text: 4. Agni the God was made the great High-Priest of Gods, Rsis have kindled Agni, men of mortal mould.
Agni I invocate for winning ample wealth. kindly disposed for winning wealth.
paragraphs.original: अग्निं महो धनसातावहं हुवे मृळीकं धनसातये
paragraphs.translit: agniṃ maho dhanasātāvahaṃ huve mṛḷīkaṃ dhanasātaye

paragraphs.text: 5. Atri and Bharadvaja and Gavisthira, Kanva and Trasadasyu, in our fight he helped.
paragraphs.original: अग्निरत्रिं भरद्वाजं गविष्ठिरं प्रावन्नः कण्वं त्रसदस्युमाहवे ।
paragraphs.translit: agniratriṃ bharadvājaṃ gaviṣṭhiraṃ prāvannaḥ kaṇvaṃ trasadasyumāhave |

paragraphs.text: On Agni calls Vasistha, even the household priest, the household priest to win his grace.
paragraphs.original: अग्निं वसिष्ठो हवते पुरोहितो मृळीकाय पुरोहितः
paragraphs.translit: agniṃ vasiṣṭho havate purohito mṛḷīkāya purohitaḥ
